items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And that is why Lester had been fired out of Fletcher Henderson's band because he didn't have a big tone.

ctx.x: Well actually Lester did get much more attention from the public and critics than Herschel, didn't he?

Yes. But Herschel got quite a bit of attention from playing, from having such a big sound, big tone on the tenor because most tenor players didn't have that big tone. And that is why Lester had been fired out of Fletcher Henderson's band because he didn't have a big tone.
